personality.title: Personality Traits
personality.socialStyle_extrovert_desc: You recharge with social interaction, enjoy being with people, and sharing ideas out loud.
personality.socialStyle_introvert_desc: You prefer quiet spaces, recharge in solitude, and think before you speak.
personality.socialStyle_ambivert_desc: You adapt depending on the context: sometimes social, sometimes reserved. A flexible balance.
personality.processingStyle_analytical_desc: Breaks down problems into parts, seeks logic, patterns, and precision.
personality.processingStyle_creative_desc: Generates original ideas, connects unexpected concepts, thinks outside the box.
personality.processingStyle_practical_desc: Seeks functional solutions, applies what has been learned, focuses on the useful.
personality.processingStyle_dreamer_desc: Imagines scenarios, reflects deeply, connects with the emotional and symbolic.
personality.processingStyle_intuitive_desc: Makes quick decisions based on hunches or internal sensations.
personality.processingStyle_reflective_desc: Thinks before acting, analyzes consequences, needs time to process.
personality.processingStyle_sequential_desc: Prefers following ordered steps, structures information in linear processes.
personality.processingStyle_global_desc: Sees the big picture, connects big ideas before going into details.
personality.processingStyle_sensorial_desc: Learns better with physical stimuli: seeing, touching, hearing, experimenting.
personality.processingStyle_verbal_desc: Processes better through language, reading, writing, and conversation.
personality.processingStyle_visual_desc: Prefers images, diagrams, mind maps to understand and remember.
personality.riskTolerance_conservative_desc: Prefers stability, avoids unnecessary risks, values safety and control.
personality.riskTolerance_balanced_desc: Evaluates risks with logic, adapts according to context, seeks balance between safety and opportunity.
personality.riskTolerance_risky_desc: Makes bold decisions, feels comfortable with uncertainty, seeks rapid growth.
personality.decisionMaking_rational_desc: Analyzes data, logic, and consequences before deciding.
personality.decisionMaking_emotional_desc: Decides based on feelings, prioritizes bonds, empathy, and personal values.
personality.decisionMaking_intuitive_desc: Trusts hunches, decides quickly, without needing much information.

cognitive.title: Neurodiversity & Extras
cognitive.neurodiversity_diagnosed_help: Check this box if you have a formal diagnosis from a health professional. If you are not diagnosed, your selection will be treated as self-identification.
cognitive.neurodiversity_self_id_help: If you have not been professionally diagnosed, this selection is considered self-identification. It will not be used for compatibility or shown publicly without your consent.
cognitive.neurodiversity_show: Show this section on my public profile
cognitive.neurodiversity_help_text: Neurodiversity recognizes that differences in brain functioning are natural variations of the human genome.
cognitive.learning_help:
How do you process information best?
Knowing your learning style helps us suggest better ways to communicate and collaborate with other users.
cognitive.learning_visual_desc: You learn best with images, diagrams, and colors.
cognitive.learning_auditory_desc: You retain best what you hear, music, and rhythm.
cognitive.learning_kinesthetic_desc: You learn by doing, moving, and physical experimentation.
cognitive.learning_verbal_desc: You prefer reading, writing, and speaking to learn.
cognitive.learning_logical_desc: You need structure, sequences, and logical patterns.
cognitive.learning_social_desc: You learn best in groups sharing ideas.
cognitive.learning_solitary_desc: You prefer learning alone, in silence, and with reflection.

docManager.title: Takardar Asali
docManager.infoTooltip:
Don tabbatar da asali, ɗora bayyanannen hoton takardarka ta hukuma. 
  
Tabbatar da:
• Hoton a bayyane yake ana karantawa
• Cikakken sunanka yana bayyana
• Ranar haihuwarka tana bayyana
• Takardar tana aiki

Ƙungiyarmu za ta duba bayananka kuma za su kasance lafiya.
